clauses: Before `ts-settings-row` is clicked, no `ts-settings-routes` row is shown

With `acceptRoutes` false, `acceptDns` true and no issue, `ts-issue` is absent and the plain-text `ts-settings-routes-why` mentions "route" and lies below `ts-settings-routes`; `acceptRoutes` true hides it, false shows it again

`ts-settings-routes-switch` is unchecked; a routes click records `setAcceptRoutes(true)` and the switch waits; once `acceptRoutes` is true it is checked, and a second click records `setAcceptRoutes(false)`
With `acceptDns` true the DNS switch is checked; a click records `setAcceptDns(false)`; it stays checked after its own click and is unchecked once `acceptDns` is false
After a 403 disables the switches, exactly one `ts-settings-routes-why` is still shown
